A click-by-click walkthrough for Saad. Use fictional callers and a prepared case, then ask Adnan which workflow to pilot. Keep this guide in one tab and the M Law workspace in another.

Before you leave · 3 minutes

  1. On your laptop, open this hosted link in Chrome or Edge and sign in with the same ChatGPT account that owns this preview. A different account has not been invited.
  2. Open Start here · onboarding below and click Start the walkthrough once. It adds the fictional Taylor Example case and a recorded drafting example to this browser, without replacing existing records.
  3. Return here, turn up laptop audio and follow step 1. Use normal browsing, not an incognito window. Keep the same browser throughout the meeting.
  4. Use Print / save guide for an offline cue sheet. Internet is required to load the hosted preview; offline app operation is not guaranteed.
Prepare the walkthrough ↗Open operating model ↗

What travels with you: the website, Maya's recorded multilingual speech, typed conversations, lead capture, calendar reservations, case workflows and internal review. Records you create stay in that laptop browser; they do not synchronize with this computer.

What does not: the local live drafting agent and microphone service. This hosted preview does not expose your API key or connect to the original computer. The loopback address 127.0.0.1:3333 will not open that computer from your laptop. Use the clearly labeled saved draft in step 4.

“Adnan, I want to show you one inquiry moving through reception, appointments, case preparation and attorney review in a connected workspace. Then we can choose the first workflow to pilot with your team.”

01 / 90 SECONDS

Meet Maya. Capture an inquiry.

Open Maya · reception ↗

Click Talk to Maya. Choose Urdu, Hindi, Arabic or Spanish and click the greeting button if playback needs a click. Then switch to English for the following entries.

Click “New inquiry,” then enter

Avery Example
+1 212 555 0177
This is a fictional demonstration. I was rear-ended in Queens on October 25, 2026. I would like to discuss next steps with an attorney.

Click Yes, save when she summarizes the details.

What to expect

Maya confirms the inquiry was saved and displays a new matter reference. A new intake record and a conflict-review task are created in this browser.

“The inquiry is captured once, and the team gets a concrete next action.”

Use the typed field and choice buttons on this hosted version. The live microphone button is unavailable. The saved phone number is fictional; no call or text is sent.

02 / 60 SECONDS

Reserve the consultation.

Open reception ↗

In Maya, choose Book a consultation. Enter Avery Example and +1 212 555 0177 again. Select the first offered future slot, then click Yes, save.

Expect: a booking receipt. Close Maya and reopen the reception page to see Avery in Consultation calendar, marked Reserved, plus a conflict-review task. Times are New York time. No external invitation is sent.

“The reservation and the follow-up work are visible to the office. A lawyer still decides whether to accept the case.”

03 / 60 SECONDS

Follow the new matter.

Open Matters & intake ↗

In the search field, enter Avery Example. Open the matching matter.

Expect: the inquiry summary, phone, language, Intake stage and linked review task. The new intake starts with owner Unassigned; explain that assignment is a staff decision.

“This is the record the team works from. They verify the facts, complete conflict review and assign the responsible attorney.”

Optional: open Tasks & deadlines to show the new intake and consultation-review tasks.

04 / 90 SECONDS

Show the recorded live draft.

Open Attorney review ↗

Find Recorded live drafting sample — Taylor Example and click Open exact work product. Taylor is a separate, prepared fictional case.

Expect: a recorded-example notice, an intake summary, missing-evidence list, Spanish follow-up and attorney review items. This output was generated from the selected matter on November 12, 2026; it is not being generated again on your laptop.

“We ran this against the connected drafting service. It used the selected case, marked unverified facts and prepared a Spanish follow-up. Here is the saved output and its review step.”

Optional review demonstration: choose Return for revision, type RETURN and click Record decision. Expect Returned for revision. This records a simulated internal decision; it sends nothing. Leave it pending if you want to reopen the full example repeatedly.

If the card is absent, go back to Start here · onboarding and click Start the walkthrough. Do not use Restore demo: it replaces browser records.

05 / OPTIONAL 60 SECONDS

Prepare something during the meeting.

Open Case preparation ↗

Select Taylor Example. Under Medical records follow-up, click Prepare workflow. In the workflow queue click Review output.

Expect: a structured draft/checklist and a review task. This built-in workflow works in the hosted browser. It does not retrieve medical records or make a new model call.

To queue it: open Attorney review, choose Case acceptance, select Medical records follow-up — Taylor Example, then Request attorney review.

Agree the pilot and the ownership.

In Software inventory, enter only confirmed product names, monthly equivalent cost, owner/export contact, category, renewal date and replacement notes. Refer to the researched operating model; its vendor examples are assumptions, not M Law's confirmed subscriptions.

“Which workflow consumes the most staff time? Let’s assign an owner, prove that one workflow in parallel, and then decide what subscription can be retired.”

If something stalls

  • No sound: click Maya's greeting button, check laptop volume and whether the tab is muted.
  • Cannot sign in: use the owning ChatGPT account. Do not change the site's sharing during the meeting.
  • No recorded draft: Start here · onboarding → Start the walkthrough.
  • Fresh AI question: say “The connected drafting service is on the original computer. This laptop has the workflow preview and the saved verified example.” Do not present its record-summary fallback as a live answer.
  • Internet interruption: use the printed guide and explain the workflow. The hosted demo is not guaranteed offline.
